overview: 印尼弗洛勒斯强震救援持续，黎巴嫩停火再受高伤亡空袭冲击；AI 雷达关注 EVOKE 长视频世界状态、Qwen3.8-27B 与 Agents SDK 确定性测试。

items.title: Alaya-EVOKE 以外置世界状态延长交互式视频的一致性
items.summary: EVOKE 以可读写和淘汰的几何 world-state bank 承载持久状态，并把长时 teacher 蒸馏为三步视频生成 student。
items.why_it_matters: 外置状态为交互式长视频提供了不同于无限扩展注意力上下文的工程路径。
items.uncertainty: 预印本尚未同行评审，完整训练含未公开内部视频；性能为作者自报，长时评测配置将状态库限制为约 90 秒的已观察几何，且未见独立复现。

ai.artifact_status: arXiv preprint not peer reviewed, with Apache-2.0 code and public non-gated weights; full retraining data are not public
ai.technical_takeaway: 按相机位姿索引的外置几何状态库可以把长时一致性从去噪器上下文中分离，再用分布匹配蒸馏为低步数生成器。
ai.evidence_level: primary non-peer-reviewed preprint plus public code and weights; author-reported benchmarks, no independent replication and incomplete training-data reproducibility

heat.label: highest within the August 14 Hugging Face Daily Papers list and early cross-platform attention; not evidence of validity or reproduction

signals.observation: 111 upvotes and 2 comments; highest within the August 14 daily list
57 stars and 4 forks for the code repository

items.title: Qwen3.8-27B 开放 27B 稠密视觉语言模型权重
items.summary: Qwen3.8-27B 采用 Gated DeltaNet 与 Gated Attention 交替的 27B 稠密多模态主干，并公开 BF16 与 FP8 权重。
items.why_it_matters: 模型把原生视觉、长上下文和智能体编码能力带到可自行部署的 27B 尺度。
items.uncertainty: 100 万上下文为扩展配置；训练数据、安全报告和污染检查披露有限，基准均为厂商自评。

ai.artifact_status: official release metadata dated August 14, with public non-gated Apache-2.0 BF16 and FP8 weights; weight commits predate the stated public release
ai.technical_takeaway: 64 层主干由 16 组构成，每组精确包含 3 层 Gated DeltaNet 和 1 层 Gated Attention，在约 27.8B 稠密多模态模型中兼顾长上下文成本、视觉输入和工具型任务。
ai.evidence_level: official model cards and downloadable weights with vendor-reported benchmarks; no complete training-data or system-safety report and no independent benchmark replication

heat.label: strong early attention within Hugging Face; counters are platform signals and cannot be summed into users or adoption

signals.observation: official BF16 page showed 9,861 likes and 91,917 downloads
official FP8 page showed 437 likes and 123,157 downloads

items.title: 更新：Agents SDK 0.21.0 增加无需供应商请求的确定性测试接口
items.summary: Agents SDK 0.21.0 新增 Agent、Sandbox、Realtime 与 Voice 的 scripted testing API，并兼容 OpenAI Python SDK v3、迁移到 HTTPX2。
items.why_it_matters: 供应商中立的确定性测试接口能让智能体状态、工具调用和流事件进入可重复的 CI 回归测试。
items.uncertainty: 测试替身不能替代真实模型和权限的端到端验证；OpenAI Python SDK v3 与 HTTPX2 迁移仍需对自定义 transport 回归。

ai.artifact_status: official release whose referenced commit is GitHub Verified, with MIT source; substantial update from v0.20.0 through new provider-neutral testing APIs and OpenAI Python SDK v3 compatibility
ai.technical_takeaway: scripted model and runtime surfaces separate SDK orchestration tests from live provider requests while hardening state snapshots, approvals and MCP lifecycle isolation.
ai.evidence_level: official release with a GitHub-verified referenced commit and public MIT source; no release-specific independent production evaluation or performance benchmark

heat.label: early release with limited version-specific reactions; repository scale is not evidence of v0.21.0 adoption

signals.observation: release page showed 1 reaction shortly after publication

items.summary: 弗洛勒斯岛附近发生 7.7 级浅源地震，至少 47 人死亡、100 多人受伤，约 5,000 人临时安置。

items.uncertainty: 死亡和失联数字仍可能上修，本期采用 AP 转述的 BNPB 较保守口径。
